
[red bold]-- TASK ERROR -- main.volt:0[/red bold]

`try` blocks are forbidden in critical tasks because the body may contain yielding operations.


[cyan]Hint: Move this to a Background or Priority task, or use expression-level `or` clauses at each call site.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]
